model_note: Qwen3-0.6B pilot; confirmatory subspace analysis planned on Qwen3-32B.
analysis: preregistered exploratory — centroid cosine + Procrustes on window-mean activation sets; PCA principal angles exploratory only. Does not decide RQ1. Do not compare raw disparity across datasets. FROZEN pilot.
interpretation: Across both datasets, prose and tool activations remain substantially aligned (cosine ≈0.8–0.9), but cannot be perfectly aligned by an orthogonal transformation, indicating measurable geometric differences without evidence of complete representational separation.
method: Mean cosine = cosine between prose and tool centroids of window-mean residual activations. Procrustes on the same centered point sets. Principal angles between PCA subspaces fit independently to each set (top-r≤4 right singular vectors). Large principal angles with high mean cosine suggest central tendency is more similar than estimated subspace orientation; descriptive only at small pilot n.
